payload.summary: Matched pilot completed with preregistered protocol 05ee687 and all six pairs. Code, contract and deferred-feature outcomes matched; no productivity advantage observed. DIP's median total time was 2.20x a strong Markdown baseline, with higher reported usage and 134 MCP calls. Independent reconstruction reproduced all 24 stage scores. Raw task counts/status are reported without claiming a semantic duplicate score. Infrastructure attempts retained. Optimization now belongs to DIP-B01.
payload.next: Run broader natural-reminder and concurrent-worker evaluations after reducing measured management friction; preserve the current pilot as a baseline.
